content.text: No MFN language exists anywhere in the agreement, and the fee/pricing provisions contain no obligation running from AP to Kubient.

input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale:
This rule is a direction check, and the agreement contains no most-favoured-nation, "best terms" or "no less favourable" provision at all — searches for "most favoured/favorable", "no less favorable" and "terms offered to" return nothing, and a full read of the single operative section confirms none. The Fees and Payment clause (§5, p0023) is a straightforward revenue-share/sequential-liability provision with no obligation for AP to extend Kubient pricing or terms it gives to any third party. To the contrary, §1 (p0001) expressly preserves AP's freedom to offer Inventory through other agents or sell to third parties on any terms, which is inconsistent with any implied MFN burden on us. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer); no redline is warranted. We note only that the agreement also grants AP no MFN in its favour, which is welcome but not required — a point for commercial negotiation rather than a playbook deviation.</parationale>
